mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_inventory_lock(lock_no,agent_id,product_model_id,lock_qty,expire_time,created_by,status,remark) SELECT #{lockNo},a.id,#{request.productModelId},#{request.lockQty},#{expireTime},COALESCE(#{createdBy},0),'LOCKED',#{request.remark} FROM bike_agent a WHERE a.id=#{request.agentId} AND a.status='ENABLED'
INSERT INTO bike_inventory_lock_detail(lock_id,product_model_id,lock_qty) SELECT id,#{productModelId},#{lockQty} FROM bike_inventory_lock WHERE lock_no=#{lockNo}
mapper.sql: SELECT l.id,l.lock_no,a.id agent_id,a.agent_name,m.id product_model_id,m.model_name,l.lock_qty,l.released_qty,l.converted_qty,l.status,l.expire_time,l.created_at,l.remark FROM bike_inventory_lock l JOIN bike_agent a ON a.id=l.agent_id JOIN bike_product_model m ON m.id=l.product_model_id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM bike_inventory_lock WHERE lock_no=#{lockNo}
l.agent_id=#{agentId} ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bike_inventory_lock l l.agent_id=#{agentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE bike_inventory_lock SET released_qty=lock_qty-converted_qty,status='RELEASED',released_at=NOW(3),remark=CONCAT(COALESCE(remark,''),' ',#{reason}) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND expire_time>NOW(3)

UPDATE bike_inventory_lock SET converted_qty=converted_qty+#{qty},status=CASE WHEN converted_qty+#{qty} >= lock_qty-released_qty THEN 'CONVERTED' ELSE 'PARTIAL_CONVERTED' END WHERE id=#{id} AND converted_qty+released_qty+#{qty} <= lock_qty AND status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND expire_time>NOW(3)
UPDATE bike_inventory_lock SET status='EXPIRED',released_at=NOW(3) WHERE status IN ('LOCKED','PARTIAL_CONVERTED') AND expire_time<=NOW()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bike_operation_log(business_type,business_id,action,operator_id,operator_name,before_data,after_data,client_ip,remark) VALUES(CASE WHEN #{action}='释放库存锁定' THEN 'INVENTORY_RELEASE' ELSE 'INVENTORY_LOCK' END,#{businessId},#{action},#{operatorId},#{operatorName},JSON_OBJECT('status','LOCKED'),JSON_OBJECT('action',#{action}),#{clientIp},#{remark})
